title: Achievements made by Ministry of Women and Child Development under Special Campaign 6.0
subtitle:
Cleanliness activities undertaken in more than 12 lakh field Institutions under the special campaign
51,090 grievances disposed during the dedicated one-day event as part of special campaign 6.0
body_text: Ministry of Women and Child Development, including all Autonomous/ Statutory Bodies under its administrative control, had initiated efforts and finalised action plans & targets to implement Special Campaign 6 for improving Swachhata and disposal of pending references from 2 nd October - 31 st October, 2026. The Special Campaign aimed at promoting cleanliness streamlining work, addressing pending grievances across the Ministry and its Autonomous Bodies. As part of the implementation phase of Special Campaign 6, States and UTs had organised a dedicated special one-day event on 30 th October, 2026 by undertaking the following activities on a large scale with active participation of field-level functionaries and the community: Cleanliness Drives at Field-Level Institutions Effective Public Grievance Redressal and organizing Grievance Redressal Chaupal/e-Chaupals for redressal of grievances received under the schemes of the Ministry through POSHAN Tracker, PMMVY & CPGRAMS portal. On account of the concerted efforts made by the Ministry as well as State Government functionaries as part of dedicated special one-day event, cleanliness drives & public grievance redressal campaigns were conducted on a large scale in the field institutions functional under the schemes of the Ministry viz. Anganwadi Centres, Child Care Institutions, Shakti Sadans, Sakhi Niwas, Creches etc. As a result of the same cleanliness activities were undertaken in 12,08,313 field institutions located all over the country under the special campaign & 51,090 grievances were disposed during the dedicated one-day event. In addition to the above, 5,51,653 other activities such as plantation drives, handwash messages to beneficiaries of Anganwadi and other field institutions were undertaken in the said institutions. Further, the Ministry recognised and appreciated the services of Safai Mitras and sanitation workers for their contribution towards sustaining cleanliness. The Safai Mitras were felicitated with new uniforms and awards as a mark of appreciation for the dedicated services of all Safai Mitras who work throughout the year to maintain a clean and hygienic campus. Grievance Redressal Chaupals organised in Mizoram as part of one-day event under Special Campaign 6 * *** RC
